web-guide-idea-62.audience: NRI families wanting practical Hindi together.
web-guide-idea-62.offer: Offer guardian-managed family learning around everyday situations. Keep the activity age-appropriate and explain who should attend with a child.
web-guide-idea-62.steps.0: Send a simple preparation note to guardians.
web-guide-idea-62.steps.1: Teach a few words through a story or household activity.
web-guide-idea-62.steps.2: Let families practise a short exchange and recap.
web-guide-idea-62.equipment: A phone, clear audio and simple household props. Guardians manage participation.
web-guide-idea-62.returnReason: Build a sequence around meals, relatives, shopping and festivals so families can use the language between sessions.
web-guide-idea-62.promotion: Show a short family-friendly activity and clearly name the intended level and guardian role.

web-guide-idea-62.metadataDescription: Teach useful Hindi through stories, songs and everyday situations in guardian-managed family sessions. Learn what to offer, how to start and what equipment you need.
